newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cyprus Amax estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cyprus Amax estimate cut.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Friday it lowered its estimate for Cyprus Amax Minerals Co for fiscal 1997 earnings to $1.42 a share from $3.20 to reflect low by-product prices.

-- The company on Wednesday reported an after-tax charge of $61 million in the fourth quarter ended December 31 associated with the Copper/Molybdenum segment. The charge was primarily for enviromental remediation and costs to temporarily close the Tohono mine, EVEREN said.
-- EVEREN said the company also wrote off its Guanaco mine in Chile, which reduced its after-tax earnings by $13 million.
--EVEREN maintained its outperform recommendation on the company's common stock.
-- Cyprus Amax is a major copper producer.
-- Its shares closed down 1/4 Friday at 23.
